content.text:
TASK:
Record a SIGN ON / SESSION capability against MERIDIAN CORE. (1) On the OPERATOR SIGN ON screen type the operatorId parameter into Operator ID and the operatorPassword parameter into the credential field. (2) For Branch call choose with option = the branch parameter value verbatim (it is the option's underlying value, e.g. MAIN-001). (3) Click Sign On. (4) You land on the MAIN MENU. Use read to capture the signed-on operator identity shown in the status bar into an output named 'sessionBanner'. (5) Then probe one exceptional state: begin_probe BAD_CREDENTIALS, sign off, and attempt to sign on again with a deliberately incorrect credential such as 'zzqqxx123', then declare_outcome BAD_CREDENTIALS. IMPORTANT for the marker: choose a span of text you can literally see on that failed screen that contains NO credential value and no member data — the harness will reject a marker that redaction would mask, so prefer the leading part of the error message or a heading. (6) declare_done with capability_id 'session.signOn'.

PARAMETERS:
- branch (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'branch'. — value: "MAIN-001"
- operatorId (internal): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_ID) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: "teller1"
- operatorPassword (secret): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)

The application is served at https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com. The browser is currently blank — begin by navigating to the application.

input.intent: Open the MERIDIAN CORE application to reach the OPERATOR SIGN ON screen.
